mu_name_from: _enum.h:1514 MODEL_DIVINE_SWORD_OF_ARCHANGEL = MODEL_SWORD + 19, loaded from Item/Sword20.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:623); group 0 number 19 in OpenMU S6 Weapons.cs:156.
why_this_one: The second Statue of Saint (133) carries it over its coffin (ZzzCharacter.cpp:8952-8966; WebZen raises one of the three statues at random, BC_SAINT_STATUE_1 + rand()%3, BloodCastle.cpp:2216) and gives it up when broken; carried back to the Archangel it wins the castle, as the Divine Staff does. A weapon that drops in Icarus as well (stats.note). docs/blood-castle-port.md.

stats.from: OpenMU S6 Weapons.cs:156: CreateWeapon(0, 19, 0, 22, 1, 4, false, "Divine Sword of Archangel", 86, 220, 230, 45, 168, 0, 0, 140, 50, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0) -- drop 86, 220-230, speed 45, knight.
stats.note: A real weapon again since 2026-10-10 (the user: 'allow to drops archangel weapons, i guess starting on icarus', 'make theam dropable items and place there drop there they logciallly can start to drop'), replacing the quest-item rule of 2026-10-03: MU's own row, wearable by its classes, sold and dropped as any weapon. It drops from its drop level up, which puts it in Icarus (Drakan 86, Great Drakan 100, the Dark Phoenix 108) and Tarkan's deepest. Blood Castle's Statue of Saint still gives one up and the Archangel still takes a plain one back (Realm::staffSlot). drops_from_monsters is ours: OpenMU and WebZen keep it off the drop table.

sheet_from: Data/Item/sword44_R.OZJ (32x64, the grey crystal blade, 128 triangles) and sword442.OZJ (16x64, the gold and black hilt, 124). Decoded from MuMain with pipeline/decode_texture.py.
material_note: As the Divine Staff's: steel, the paint its albedo. Built 2026-10-10: mesh 0's RENDER_METAL under its sliding Chrome01 is the chrome pass (chrome_from); its held lights on bones 2 to 8 are fx/held_lights' (ZzzCharacter.cpp:7491-7521).
rig_note: No .rig.json: Sword20.bmd has one action of one key (export-rig --actions=all, 2026-10-03), nothing moves; its nine bones are only where MU hangs the lights above.
material_overrides_note: As the Divine Staff's: steel's own 0.2 mirrors the scene.
tells_from: MU's own sentence for the Archangel's weapon, Game.en.resx:3049; the 'Quest item' line over it is ours (game/ui/describe.cpp).
chrome_from: RenderPartObjectBody (ZzzObject.cpp:7042-7047): mesh 0 (sword44_R) is drawn RENDER_TEXTURE | RENDER_METAL -- Shiny01 at RENDER_METAL's coordinates off the normal (ZzzBMD.cpp:1499-1502, 1683-1687), solid -- and then RENDER_LIGHTMAP with Chrome01 at its own UVs, V sliding at WorldTime*0.0001, a tenth of a sheet a second, which multiplies it: a polished sheen with chrome streaks running along it. Its own _R sheet is never drawn. Here the pass is Shiny01 times the sliding Chrome01 (its mask), added over the baked mesh rather than standing in for it (scrolls_per_second -0.1, the renderer's offset being minus the rate). tools/chrome_sheets.py.
